Question: My fiance (would be wife) has seen in the dream that there is a large gathering of people in the majlis of some pious man (Buzareg) and my fiance is also there. The Buzareg called my fiancee and told her why are you doing like this? He did not mention what she did wrong. After that he told her that Hazoor Saw is angry with you. Alhamdulillah I am attached with Tableeg work. She is not regular in prayers and sometimes we talk about sex etc. I am too much worried about it, please tell me the tabeer as soon as possible. May Almighty Allah gives you reward in this world and the hereafter Aameen. Answer ID: 23204 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1298/982/H=1431) Talking about sex etc is very hideous act that is very bad according to Sahriah too. It is better to do nikah as soon as possible and arrange to live together with good manners. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
